# Skill catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog.sh from each skill's frontmatter. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per skill in AI Skill Factory. Use it to match a project profile to
skills: **Signals** are needs that pull a skill in, **Presets** are the team
sizes that include it by default, **Phase** says when it is active.

Presets: `core` (always installed), `solo`, `small`, `medium`, `large`.
Phases: `all`, `discover`, `design`, `build`, `launch`, `operate`.
